scope: Read-only source geometry/material/UV audit. No visual fidelity, Unity import, gameplay or performance acceptance is implied.

policy.uv0Stretch: Per-triangle 3D-to-UV Jacobian singular-value ratio; tiled UV0 is allowed
policy.uv2Overlap: Bounded spatial-grid triangle intersection heuristic, not a universal exact atlas proof
